lead.title: CSL pays $355M upfront to Swiss biotech Alentis for its anti-claudin-1 antibody lixudebart
lead.deck: Up to $1.6B in total ($1.2B in milestones); CSL funds the Phase 2 RENAL trial and a planned Phase 3 in AAV-RPGN kidney vasculitis, then development in FSGS and PSC. Profits split 55% CSL / 45% Alentis: rare validation for a clinical-stage Swiss biotech.

milestone.title: Argenx: FB102 hits its Phase 2 primary endpoint in celiac disease, but the UNITY Sjögren's trial is stopped
milestone.summary: FB102 (a CD122 inhibitor acquired from Forte Biosciences for $2.2B) shows a significant effect on a small-intestine health measure. Meanwhile an independent committee halts Vyvgart Hytrulo's Phase 3 UNITY trial for futility.
milestone.why: The first Phase 2 evidence that blocking CD122 can prevent gluten-induced intestinal damage opens a new franchise; dropping Sjögren's (peak sales estimated at $1.4B) is a reminder of label-expansion risk.

deal.thesis: Shionogi pays $2B upfront for IntraBio (Aqneursa for Niemann-Pick type C and ataxia-telangiectasia; $68M 2025 sales): Jefferies estimates ~$1B peak sales. A comparable for rare disease assets with an approved product.

brefsEurope.title: Forbion raises €2.3B ($2.6B) for Growth Opportunities IV and Ventures Fund VIII
brefsEurope.summary: Forbion's largest raise ever (€7.5B under management); LPs include MN, PGGM, KfW Capital, Eli Lilly and the Kauffman Foundation. Capacity for up to 30 young biotechs: fresh European early-stage capital.

brefsEurope.title: Newron discloses 4 deaths on evenamide (0.56%) vs 1 on placebo; FDA clinical hold maintained
brefsEurope.summary: The hold covers Phase 3 ENIGMA-TRS 2 in schizophrenia; recruitment continues outside the US. Newron is weighing enhanced cardiac monitoring (10,000+ ECGs, ~700 patients).

brefsEurope.title: Dutch court bars Merck from subcutaneous Keytruda in 8 European countries (Halozyme patent)
brefsEurope.summary: Belgium, Denmark, France, Ireland, Italy, Sweden, Switzerland and the Netherlands: the court finds Keytruda SC infringes Halozyme's MDASE patent. A precedent for subcutaneous formulation IP.

brefsIntl.title: TRex Bio raises $117M in an IPO at $14 a share for its Treg-targeting TNFR2 agonist
brefsIntl.summary: TRB-061 is in Phase 1 (data expected in 2027); Eli Lilly held ~24% before the IPO. A sign the Nasdaq is reopening for immunology.

brefsIntl.title: Novartis pays $575M upfront to Abogen for an mRNA-encoded CD3×CD19 T cell engager
brefsIntl.summary: Up to $7.8B in total (~$7.2B in milestones): the product is made in vivo from mRNA, an alternative to cell therapies.

word.full: Chimeric Antigen Receptor Regulatory T cell
word.fr: Chimeric antigen receptor regulatory T cell
word.definition: A patient's regulatory T cell fitted with a chimeric receptor that calms an immune reaction at the right place instead of killing cells.

how.t: The patient's Tregs are isolated and expanded.
A CAR is inserted so they recognise a specific tissue or target.
Once reinfused, they inhibit several neighbouring immune cells (a "bystander" effect).

word.why: VC angle: the opposite of cytotoxic CAR-T for autoimmunity and transplant, with AstraZeneca and Regeneron already partnered on Tregs and TRex Bio's October 9 IPO.

startups.name: Quell Therapeutics
startups.use: CAR-Treg QEL-005 (CD19) in the CHILL Phase 1/2 trial in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic sclerosis after MHRA CTA approval; early data expected Q1 2027

startups.name: Sonoma Biotherapeutics
startups.use: Treg therapies (candidate SBT-77-7101) co-developed 50/50 with Regeneron ($75M upfront, 2023) in IBD
